review: 14-agent adversarial workflow (5 dimension reviewers + per-finding skeptical verifiers), run on the C0 build BEFORE the owner's focused review, 2026-09-01
headline: 1 CRITICAL claim REFUTED (its hardening adopted anyway); 7 distinct CONFIRMED non-minor defects, ALL FIXED and the battery rerun; the estimator, corruption law, cache verifier, mutation honesty, QC surface wording, pid tags, and receipt determinism all strengthened before freeze

critical_refuted.claim: Test B's 5-batch-mean-loss criterion can be curve-fit: an init search matched the base's mean losses to 1e-4 with R held fixed, so PROOF_OF_NON_EQUIVARIANCE fails at its own criterion
critical_refuted.why: the fitted twin is not an absorption: along the same trajectory its max PER-EXAMPLE loss difference is 1.681 (signal-scale divergence) and it differs 1.084e-2 on held-out data (10x the floor); the identical attack also 'absorbs' the non-isomorphic R_RANDOM under IDENTITY labels, so the attack criterion is vacuous; and the recorded claim is recipe-scoped (spec section 3), which the attack does not address
critical_refuted.hardening_adopted_anyway: criterion upgraded from 5 batch means to per-example loss trajectories (steps x n residuals; the verifier measured the attack stalling at 3.5e-2 against per-example residuals, 35x above floor) + a second data seed on Test B + explicit scope law in spec and docstrings

confirmed_fixed.finding: R_EMPIRICAL's C plane was transcribed, not estimated: result/mediator types were hard-coded family-keyed literals duplicating the CAS cell content, so the 16/16 C-overlap was convergence by construction presented as measurement (one verifier CONFIRMED; a duplicate filing DOWNGRADED_MINOR after showing a genuine estimator reproduces the identical structure)
confirmed_fixed.fix: genuine slot/pool-typed estimator implemented (mediator = literal shared entity typed by surface pool; result = answer/list product typed by pool; no family->type table); cell provenance now records the measured histograms; spec section 4 rewritten; overlap is now a genuine measurement

confirmed_fixed.finding: QC_VALID's 'identical surface statistics by construction' over-claimed: string-swap twins cancel only ORDER-INSENSITIVE statistics, and gold is a function of order, so order-sensitive shallow cues (e.g. clause length order) correlate with gold (verifier reproduced the effect)
confirmed_fixed.fix: registered char-level surface adversary (HashingVectorizer char 3-5 + LogisticRegression) + length-order rule, both persisted as the QC surface ceiling (disclosure); spec and docstring wording corrected; interpretation law re-stated: the QC readout is the CONTRAST between R-variants at matched surface exposure
